name: Fast and cheap
useFor: Quick drafts, rewording, short answers and brainstorming lists, anything you will check or rewrite anyway.
effortAdvice: Low effort is usually enough. Raise it only if the answers feel shallow.

name: Balanced everyday
useFor: Everyday writing, explaining ideas, summarising short material and most questions.
effortAdvice: Medium effort is a good default. Go higher only for harder questions.

name: Deep reasoning
useFor: Planning, multi-step problems, trade-off decisions and anything where a wrong answer is costly.
effortAdvice: Use high effort for plans and hard problems. It is slower and may use more of your limit.

name: Long documents
useFor: Reading and comparing long files, whole chapters, big pasted notes or many pages at once.
effortAdvice: Medium effort is usually enough. The size of what you give it matters more than the effort setting.

name: Coding
useFor: Writing, reading and fixing code, and explaining error messages.
effortAdvice: Medium effort for small edits. High effort for design decisions or bugs you cannot find.

name: Image
useFor: Making or editing pictures from a text description.
effortAdvice: Start with a short prompt and refine it. Many image tools have no effort setting.
